response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including C/C++ (LabWindows/CVI at National Instruments) and high-performance systems (DLang at Dunnhumby, Optilyz, and GISCollective). However, his recent roles focus heavily on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and front-end technologies (React, Ember.js), with limited recent exposure to C++ or industrial automation-specific protocols (e.g., Modbus, OPC UA). His expertise in cybersecurity standards or IEC 62443 is not evident from the resume.
strengths: Strong C/C++ background with hands-on experience in low-latency and high-performance systems
Experience with event-driven architectures and modular design (GISCollective, Optilyz)
Proven track record in delivering scalable solutions (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last substantial role with C/C++ was 2015; recent roles emphasize JavaScript/TypeScript)
No clear evidence of industrial automation or IoT protocol experience (e.g., Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT)
No mention of secure development lifecycle (SDL) or IEC 62443 compliance in current or past roles

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation or IoT protocol knowledge
Secure development lifecycle (SDL) and IEC 62443 experience
